newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NSW budget deficit A$185 mln to November.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NSW budget deficit A$185 mln to November.

text.p: The underlying budget deficit for the state of New South Wales was A$185 million for the five months to November 30, Treasurer Michael Egan said.
This compares with a deficit of A$478 million in the same period last year and a deficit of A$301 million for the four months to October 30, Egan said in a statement.
He said the improved result was mainly due to higher than anticipated revenue from government trading enterprises and taxes, fees and fines, offset by higher departmental payments.
